_comment: Invented game 'Starfall' for the AWS-free retrieval regression subset. All text is original; no third-party rulebook content.

chunks.text: Each round, players take turns clockwise starting with the captain. On your turn you must take exactly one main action: Launch, Survey or Trade.
To launch a scout ship, pay 3 fuel and place the ship on any orbit adjacent to your home station.
When you survey a nebula, draw two star cards and keep one. Discard the other star card face down.
Whenever a comet passes your scout ship, gain 1 renown immediately, even during another player's turn.
Renown milestones are resolved at the end of the turn, after the active player finishes. Resolve the active player's milestones first, then continue clockwise.
Beacon effects trigger when a ship ends its movement on a beacon. Resolve beacon effects before milestones.
There is no hand limit during the round. At the end of the round, discard down to five star cards.
At game end, each surveyed nebula scores 2 points and each completed constellation scores 5 points.
Clarification: a survey that draws a comet card does not end your turn. Resolve the comet first, then keep one star card.
Errata: to launch a scout ship from a captured station costs 2 fuel instead of 3 fuel.
How much fuel to launch a scout ship? To launch a scout ship, pay 4 fuel and place the ship on any orbit adjacent to your home station.
Promo rule: how much fuel to launch a scout ship? With the Pilot card, to launch a scout ship costs no fuel.
